shared_elements: carved stone slab/stela with relief on a single face
suggestion of a schematic figure or face occupying the upper field
justification: A shows a dense, curvilinear low-relief composition of interlocking scrolls, volutes and rectilinear glyph-like panels covering the whole face, while B shows only broad, sculpted swellings and hollows suggesting a crude schematic body or face with paired eye-like depressions and a central ridge. Beyond both being reliefs on a roughly triangular/slab-shaped stone with some upper-field motif, there is no shared specific motif, no comparable relationships between elements, and the depiction conventions (fine incised curvilinear ornament versus massive undetailed modelling) are entirely different.
